theorems.name: Submission.ball_harmonic_patching
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ w : Rn n → ℝ, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → ∃ v : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd v (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - ε)) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - 2 * ε))), v x = w x) → ∃ u : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), u x = w x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
